SELECT d.fiscal_year, min(d.calendar_date) mn, max(d.calendar_date) mx, count(*) n, min(d.fiscal_period) p0, max(d.fiscal_period) p1,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-04-29' AND '2025-04-27') AS dup_sales_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2024-04-29' AND '2025-04-27') AS dup_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_line

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_keys,
  count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) n_loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l1,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-04-29' AND '2025-04-27' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_fy2425
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING (receipt_id, line_no)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS category_as_was, p.subcategory AS sub_as_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.channel_code
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net, NULL
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, n.category_as_was, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.sub_as_was ILIKE '%light%' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS lighting_part
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was ILIKE '%garden%'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3

SELECT 'web_status_in_range' k, o.status || ' / ' || coalesce(p.category,'') a, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-05-05' AND p.category='Garden' AND o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'garden_versions', p.category || ' / ' || p.subcategory || ' / ' || cast(p.is_current as varchar), count(DISTINCT p.sku), count(*)
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.category='Garden' OR p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE category='Garden') GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', 'x', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND r.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1),
orphan AS (
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
          WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND (p.product_key IS NULL OR s.store_key IS NULL)) AS sales_orphans,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
          WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND (p.product_key IS NULL OR s.store_key IS NULL)) AS return_orphans)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.v mine, c.c control, m.v - c.c gap, o.sales_orphans, o.return_orphans
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) CROSS JOIN orphan o ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS garden_net_sales_as_was
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
